records.summary: All college-level coursework from post-secondary degree-granting institutions in good standing with their accreditor is evaluated for transfer. UTC does not award credit for courses from educational companies such as Sophia Learning, StraighterLine or Study.com. Articulation agreements with Tennessee community colleges let associate-degree holders complete a baccalaureate at UTC. The 2026-2027 Clear Path for Advising program sheets list, for each bachelor's degree reviewed, 30 hours at UTC, 45 hours at a 4-year institution and 39 upper-division hours.

residency_rules.text: Hours at UTC: 30 (2026-2027 Clear Path for Advising sheets).
Hours at 4-year Institution: 45 (2026-2027 Clear Path for Advising sheets).

records.notes: The registrar page states no minimum transfer grade, two-year-college hour cap or final-hours residence rule. The 2026-2027 catalog (catalog.utc.edu, catoid=53) Degree and Graduation Requirements and Academic Regulations pages could not be read with available tools. Residency hours come from program sheets, not the catalog policy text. Read 2026-10-02 through a fetch tool that returns a model summary of the page rather than raw text; values have not yet been confirmed against the raw page, so the record stays partially_verified.
